svg.aria-label: Checks come from routes and from one hand-written file: 1. Discover: The gatus-sidecar watches HTTPRoutes and Services, and writes each route with a Gatus endpoint annotation into the shared config. 2. Merge: config.yaml adds what no route shows: the WAN, the Radarr queue, the Hermes gateway, and the ToolHive MCP session. 3. Probe: Gatus polls each endpoint on its own interval and keeps the results in SQLite on a 512 MiB ceph-block volume. 4. Alert: Metrics reach Prometheus. GatusEndpointDown (external group, 5 min) is critical; GatusServiceDown (other groups, 10 min) is a warning. 5. Show: The status page is served on the internal Gateway. The Homepage Gatus widget reads the same API.
